families.overview: Schneider Electric (Square D) offers, through a retrofit form submitted via distributor to the local sales office (panel TAG group feasibility review), a custom trim built to fit an existing Schneider or competitor enclosure combined with a standard current-style NQ or NF interior. Enclosures 17 in wide and above take the standard 20 in W NQ/NF interior; narrower ones take the 'RTI' 14 in W NQ interior. NEMA 1 only (no N3R). Existing box studs are not used; the contractor centres the interior, shims as needed and fastens the mounting rails to the box back wall by any means. Square D does not offer QO/Homeline load center retrofit interiors.

box_range.value: Enclosures >=17 in W: standard 20 in W NQ and NF interiors; enclosures <17 in W: 'RTI 14"W NQ interiors'; an NQ or NF panel can be up to 3 in longer than the existing enclosure; NEMA 1 applications only, not available for N3R
